Synopsis:
Russia launched its sixth consecutive day of strikes on Kyiv, killing 9 and injuring 12+. Strikes also disrupted a Romania border crossing on the Danube. Ukrainian drone retaliation hit Russian port and refinery infrastructure. Peace diplomacy is active — Zelenskyy spoke with Trump envoys Witkoff and Kushner; India's Modi urged Putin to end the war. NATO Baltic members (Latvia, Finland, Estonia) activated air defenses in response to drone activity near the Russian border.
